# <span style="color:rgb(213,80,0)">**Quick Model and Eigen Visualization**</span>

At any point during model creation, you can run the ``ops.vis.plotModel()`` or ``ops.vis.plotEigen()`` to visualize the current model’s geometric details and eigen modes.

## Model visualization
```matlab
clear
clc
```

First, instantiate the OpenSeesMatlab interface class. This class provides native OpenSees commands, as well as additional visualization, pre/post\-processing, and utility methods.

```matlab
opsMAT = OpenSeesMatlab();
ops = opsMAT.opensees;
```

For example, the `tool` property provides a function `loadExamples` to run some built\-in models. Of course, you can run your own model; the built\-in model is used here for demonstration purposes only.

```matlab
ops.wipe();
opsMAT.utils.loadExamples("ArchBridge2");
% or your model here
```

We can visualize the model using the `plotModel` function in the `vis` attribute.

```matlab
opsMAT.vis.plotModel();
```

<div style="font-weight:600;">Output</div>
<div style="white-space:pre-wrap; font-family:Consolas;">
[OpenSeesMatlab] Model summary
  Nodes: 241
  Beam elements: 367
  Shell elements: 72
</div>
</div>

<center><img src="data:image/png;base64," width="1004" alt="figure_0.png"></center>

We can retrieve data from the current model, which returns a nested `struct`. You can view the data using MATLAB's workspace variables.

```matlab
modelData = opsMAT.post.getModelData();
disp(modelData)
```

    MPConstraint: [1x1 struct]

</div>
</div>

Finally, we can customize the control parameters for model visualization. Let's first take a look at the default parameter settings.

```matlab
opts = opsMAT.vis.defaultPlotModelOptions;
disp(opts)
```

## Eigen visualization

First, we need to save the eigenvalue analysis results data for future reuse.

Then, data is retrieved from the file, returning a nested `structure` that stores the various results of the eigenvalue analysis.

```matlab
tag = 1;
opsMAT.post.saveEigenData(tag, 10, solver='-genBandArpack');  % save
eigenData = opsMAT.post.getEigenData(odbTag=tag);  % get
disp(eigenData)
```

<div style="font-size:0.85em; color:#87ae73;">
<div style="font-weight:600;">Output</div>
<div style="white-space:pre-wrap; font-family:Consolas;">
EigenVectors: [1x1 struct]
    InterpolatedEigenVectors: [1x1 struct]
                  ModalProps: [1x1 struct]
                   ModelInfo: [1x1 struct]
                    ModeTags: [10x1 double]
</div>
</div>

Using this data, we can visualize the first modal shapes.

```matlab
opsMAT.vis.plotEigen(1, eigenData);
```

<center><img src="data:image/png;base64," width="1004" alt="figure_3.png"></center>

and 5th

```matlab
opsMAT.vis.plotEigen(5, eigenData);
```

<center><img src="data:image/png;base64," width="1004" alt="figure_4.png"></center>

Similarly, we obtain the default parameters.

```matlab
opts = opsMAT.vis.defaultPlotEigenOptions;
disp(opts.help)
```

<div style="font-size:0.85em; color:#87ae73;">
<div style="font-weight:600;">Output</div>
<div style="white-space:pre-wrap; font-family:Consolas;">
====== PlotEigen Options ============================================


-- General layout ----------------------------------------------
  general.clearAxes     logical  Clear axes before drawing (default true).
  general.holdOn        logical  Hold axes on after drawing (default true).
  general.axisEqual     logical  Equal axis scaling (default true).
  general.grid          logical  Show grid (default true).
  general.box           logical  Show axes box (default false).
  general.view          'auto'|'xy'|'xz'|'yz'|'iso'  Camera view.
                        auto = 2-D view for planar models, 3-D otherwise.
  general.title         string   Axes title; '' = auto (mode tag + period).
  general.padRatio      double   Axis padding as fraction of model size (default 0.05).
  general.fixAxisLimits logical  Lock axis limits after first plot (default false).
  general.figureSize    [w h]    Figure size in pixels (default [1000 618]).


-- Mode shape --------------------------------------------------
  mode.modeTag          int/double  Mode tag to display (default 1).
  mode.scale            double   Manual scale multiplier applied on top of
                                 autoScale (default 1).
  mode.autoScale        logical  Auto-fit deformation to model size (default true).
                                 Scale = modelSize / (10 * maxDisp) * mode.scale.
  mode.useInterpolation logical  Use Hermite-interpolated line geometry when
                                 InterpolatedEigenVectors is present (default true).
  mode.showUndeformed   logical  Also draw undeformed ghost (default false).
  mode.component        'magnitude' | 'x' | 'ux' | 'y' | 'uy' | 'z' | 'uz'
                        Scalar field mapped onto colour (default 'magnitude').


-- Color -------------------------------------------------------
  color.useColormap     logical  Colour geometry by scalar value (default false).
  color.colormap        Nx3     Colormap matrix (default jet(256)).
  color.clim            [lo hi] Fixed colour limits; [] = auto from data.
  color.solidColor      color   Surface fill colour when useColormap=false.
  color.lineColor       color   Line colour when useColormap=false.
  color.undeformedColor color   Colour of undeformed ghost lines/edges.
  color.undeformedAlpha double  Opacity of undeformed ghost (0-1, default 1.0).
  color.deformedAlpha   double  Opacity of deformed surface (0-1, default 1.0).


-- Lines -------------------------------------------------------
  line.show                logical  Draw beam/truss/line members (default true).
  line.lineWidth           double   Deformed line width (default 1.5).
  line.undeformedLineWidth double   Undeformed ghost line width (default 0.8).
  line.lineStyle           string   Line style ('-', '--', etc., default '-').


-- Unstructured (shell / solid) --------------------------------
  unstructured.show      logical  Draw shell/solid surfaces (default true).
  unstructured.showEdges logical  Draw mesh edges on surfaces (default true).
  unstructured.edgeColor color   Mesh edge colour (default black).
  unstructured.edgeWidth double   Mesh edge line width (default 0.8).


-- Scalar / colorbar -------------------------------------------
  scalar.showColorbar            logical  Show colorbar (default true).
  scalar.useAbsoluteForComponent logical  Use |value| for non-magnitude
                                          components (default true).


-- Nodes -------------------------------------------------------
  nodes.show      logical  Scatter-plot deformed nodes (default false).
  nodes.size      double   Marker size in points (default 20).
  nodes.marker    string   Marker shape ('o', 's', etc.).
  nodes.filled    logical  Filled markers (default true).
  nodes.edgeColor color   Marker edge colour.


-- Fixed nodes -------------------------------------------------
  fixed.show      logical  Highlight fixed/constrained nodes (default true).
  fixed.size      double   Marker size in points (default 46).
  fixed.marker    string   Marker shape (default 's' = square).
  fixed.filled    logical  Filled marker (default true).
  fixed.edgeColor color   Marker edge colour.
  fixed.color     color   Marker fill colour (default dark red).


-- MP constraints ----------------------------------------------
  mpConstraint.show       logical  Draw MP constraint lines (default false).
  mpConstraint.lineWidth  double   Line width (default 1.2).
  mpConstraint.lineStyle  string   Line style (default '--').
  mpConstraint.color      color   Line colour.


-- Performance -------------------------------------------------
  performance.maxDenseLookupTag  int  Maximum tag value for direct-array
                                      index lookup; tags above this threshold
                                      fall back to containers.Map (default 5e6).


== Example =====================================================
  disp(opts.help)                    % print this help
  opts.mode.scale          = 2;
  opts.mode.showUndeformed = true;
  opts.color.useColormap   = true;
  opts.line.lineWidth      = 2.0;
=================================================================
</div>
</div>

For example:

```matlab
opts.color.useColormap = true;
% opts.color.colormap = jet(256);
modeTags = [1 3 5 7];
cmps = {"parula", "turbo", "cool", "winter"};


% Create a figure at position (100,100) with width=1200px and height=900px
figure('Position', [100, 100, 1200, 900]);
for i = 1:4
    subplot(2,2,i)
    ax = gca();
    opsMAT.vis.plotEigen(modeTags(i), eigenData, opts=opts, ax=ax);
    axis off;
    colormap(ax, cmps{i});
end
```
